data.one_liner: A Dart/Flutter client implementing the WAMP protocol for RPC and Pub/Sub.
data.what_it_does: Provides transport-agnostic communication over WebSocket, RawSocket, or local transports using WAMP. Supports authentication methods, advanced RPC and Pub/Sub features, and multiple serialization formats.
use_when: You need real‑time RPC or Pub/Sub with a WAMP router
Cross‑platform support including web, mobile, and desktop
Custom authentication (CRA, SCRAM, Ticket, Cryptosign) is required
avoid_when: A simple REST/GraphQL API would suffice
You need built‑in UI components or notifications
You prefer a higher‑level backend‑as‑a‑service SDK
strengths: Works on all major Flutter platforms
weaknesses: Not a drop‑in replacement for HTTP clients
data.setup_notes: Add the package, choose a transport (e.g., WebSocketTransport), and call client.connect(); no special permissions needed.
